name: Marquee
docs: A row (or column) of items that scrolls on its own and pauses on hover and focus. The items are the children; the same items follow once more, hidden from assistive technology, so the loop has no gap.

props.name: paused
props.docs: stop the motion; also the value under a reduced-motion preference

svelte.reason: motion needs timers, animation frames or media APIs and a reduced-motion rule; it is written by the programmer behind this contract

react.reason: motion needs timers, animation frames or media APIs and a reduced-motion rule; it is written by the programmer behind this contract
